why: A full local render. This is also the track the karaoke screenshot is driving.

A whole music video. The song, the four clips and the cover stills are all local renders; the MCP server laid the clips on the bar lines of the song's own measured grid and set the look; the editor recorded it. The colour shifts are the bass envelope driving a hue rotation — the same shot returns later in a different colour, which is the point.
LTX 2.5, the default engine — 5 s at 1280x704 in about two minutes.
Denoise 0.60 — still a copy. r = 0.94 against the near-copy end of the dial.
Denoise 0.85 — the shipped default. Waveform correlation has collapsed to 0.004: a new performance.
Denoise 0.95 — past the useful range; the reference stops steering it.
